project.name: handoverctl
project.purpose: Content-addressed handover-state snapshots with audit, revision resolution, and safe restoration.

integrity.hash_input: UTF-8 encoded canonical JSON after parsing

snapshots.deletion_policy: Do not delete or rewrite existing snapshots.

manifest_contract.current_representation: One whitespace-delimited timestamp and SHA-256 hash per line.
manifest_contract.migration_note: Despite the .jsonl extension, the current format is not JSON Lines. Do not change the parser or format without an explicit schema migration.

transport_constraints.large_direct_paste: Observed failures above approximately 50 to 80 lines on seven occasions.
transport_constraints.editor_write: Verified clean for the gated deployment.
transport_constraints.root_cause: Unidentified; stdin, bracketed paste, terminal emulator, or another transport layer has not been isolated.
transport_constraints.operating_rule: Use editor writes or small verified blocks for large changes and perform post-transfer validation.

decisions.decision: Audit canonical parsed JSON rather than raw snapshot bytes.
decisions.reason: The snapshot writer did not sort keys when writing files, while get_hash sorts keys before hashing.
Avoid modifying the verified handoverctl implementation before the audit earns trust.
Snapshots are the immutable content-addressed audit trail.

decisions.decision: Use a separate alias store unless compatibility testing proves manifest metadata safe.
decisions.reason: The existing manifest should remain append-only and backward-compatible.

next_actions.action: Integrate the standalone audit as handoverctl audit content-addressing.
next_actions.acceptance: Integrated output and exit status match audit_sessions.py.
Schema supports alias-to-revision mapping, collision detection, and revision existence checks.

requirements: Never modify snapshots or the manifest.
Require --force when replacing modified current state.

next_actions.action: Add resolver tests for full hashes, abbreviated hashes, aliases, baseline, latest, unknown selectors, and ambiguous prefixes.
Add targeted semantic diffing with deterministic dotted-path filters.
Add locking and crash-consistency tests for concurrent and interrupted writes.
Add deployment gates for compilation, tests, audit success, diff cleanliness, and clean working-tree state.

reentry_protocol: Verify the current repository and commit 1ab68fc.
Do not delete or rewrite existing snapshots.
Proceed with audit integration, alias tagging, and restoration work.

repeated_mistakes.description: Markdown-fenced content pasted directly into an interactive shell; history expansion and glob interpretation corrupted the payload and executed rule lines as commands.
repeated_mistakes.remediation: Wrap file payloads in a quoted heredoc via an atomic Python writer; never paste fenced blocks raw into the shell.

audit_log.message: Installed H003 pre-commit hook enforcing audit_sessions.py.
Legacy repair artefacts removed; confirmed untracked (commit f37ad3c).
